agent_explanation: Velocity-error law demands ~kp*|v_desired - v| ≈ 16.3*~46 ≈ 760 N, far above fmax 6.27. Steps 50,100,101 correctly clamp to 6.2705, but at step 102 the same large demand (speed 49.65 m/s, waypoint still at (0.4,5.7)) is returned unclamped as 762.86 N. Likely cause is a missed/incorrect force-magnitude clamp on that step/path (e.g. clamping skipped or applied to wrong vector), not a physics change.
